title: Status model reads an 'opus' claude worker through pi's transcript layout
body:
runnerOf returns the attempt's provenance model, which for every claude review/closeout worker is the bare 'opus' (runners.toml), and transcriptKind maps anything not containing 'claude' to pi. So a live claude worker's activity window and last action are never read: the dashboard's WORKERS panel shows an empty sparkline and no LAST for the only worker of this close-out, though its Claude Code transcript exists under ~/.claude/projects/<worktree slug>. The activity test spells the model 'claude-opus-5', a string no real record carries. Key the mapping on the executor/harness kind the attempt record names, and fix the fixture to a real record's spelling.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/activity.go:149-151 (runnerOf), :213-217 (transcriptKind); internal/statusmodel/activity_test.go:335 ('claude-opus-5'); .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/attempts/29.json provenance.model "opus"; live workers[0].activity null
